description: NLR (formerly NREL) PVWatts v8 estimate for a grid-connected PV system at a latitude and longitude: annual AC energy (kWh), capacity factor, annual solar radiation, and monthly AC energy. Uses the NSRDB typical-year weather file; this is an estimate, not a yield guarantee. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

azimuth.description: Azimuth in degrees, 0 to 360 (180 = south; default 180)

capacityKw.description: DC system size in kW, 0.05 to 1000 (default 4)
